newsitem.title: POLAND: Novita sees 1997 net up to PLN 5.4 mln.
newsitem.headline: Novita sees 1997 net up to PLN 5.4 mln.

text.p: Polish carpet maker Novita SA sees its net profit rising to 5.4 million zlotys in 1997, up from last year's 1.9 million-zlotys and the expected 4.2 million zlotys this year, the company said in a statement.

It said the forecast was based on the assumption that the company would pay no 1996 dividend and conduct no new share issue next year, but it said the final forecast would be worked out in February 1997.
It said it expected its sales to rise to 91.0 million zlotys next year, up from last year's 55.1 million and 69 million forecasted for this year.
